_readme: WoowTech Omnigent 完整指南 的中英詞彙對照。terms 為譯名對照，keepEnglish 為維持英文原樣的詞，forbid 為禁用譯法。
principles: Use US English and sentence case.
Preserve product names, harness names, configuration keys, commands, file names, versions, and placeholders exactly.
Use direct second-person instructions and retain every warning, limitation, version boundary, and verification step.
Omnigent must always be described as an orchestration layer that does not itself provide a model.
Never present any credential as a working value; placeholders only.
